title: Umurwayi
intro: Kera cyane, mu minsi ya mbere y'amateka y'abantu, abantu babiri bahagaze imbere y'Umuremyi wabo bazanye amaturo. Umwe yarakiriwe, undi ntiyakiriwe. Icyakurikiyeho cyabaye amakuba ya mbere akomeye hagati y'abavandimwe - igikorwa kimwe cyo kwihangana no kwihorera gukabije. Ese ushobora kumenya uwo ndi we?
clues: Navutse mu minsi ya mbere y'ubuzima bw'umuntu ku isi
Nari umwana w'abantu babiri ba mbere babayeho kuri iyi si
Nigeze gutanga igitambo mu mashyo yanjye meza kugira ngo nshimishe Umuremyi wanjye
Ituro ryanjye ryemejwe riturutse hejuru, mu gihe iry'umuvandimwe wanjye ryanzwe
Igihe naterwaga ubwoba bwo gupfa, nahisemo kutazamura ukuboko kwanjye kuri murumuna wanjye
Nabaye umuntu wa mbere mu mateka yose y'abantu wishwe n'undi muntu arengana

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Ubwicanyi bwa mbere mu mateka y'abantu
Igitambo cya Ismail cyakozwe na Ibrahim
trial.answer: Ubwicanyi bwa mbere mu mateka y'abantu

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yabaye uwa mbere wishwe mu mateka y'abantu
Yarokotse umwuzure ukomeye mu bwato bw'ibiti
Yazengurutse imyaka mirongo ine mu butayu bunini
outcome.answer: Yabaye uwa mbere wishwe mu mateka y'abantu

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
